task: Local Distance Network Hubble Constant Measurement
goal: Achieve ~1% precision measurement of H0 using covariance-weighted combination of multiple distance indicators

distance_ladder_rungs: Geometric anchors (MW parallaxes, LMC DEBs, NGC4258 masers)
Primary indicators (Cepheids, TRGB) measuring host galaxy distances
Secondary indicators (SN Ia, SBF) calibrated in hosts
Hubble flow observations (z > 0.02) for H0 determination

key_equations.weighted_mean: x_wavg = sum(w_i * x_i) / sum(w_i), where w_i = 1/sigma_i^2

uncertainty_treatment.systematic: Method-anchor calibration errors added in quadrature
uncertainty_treatment.peculiar_velocity: pv_err converted to magnitude error: sigma_mu = 2.17 * pv_err / (c * z)

target_outputs.primary: Consensus H0 value with total uncertainty
target_outputs.comparison: Tension significance with Planck CMB constraint
